metric_definitions.brier: mean over CAR-RACES of (p_win - is_winner)^2. Binary per car, NOT a summed multiclass Brier. The reference paper's 0.0745 sits above the p(1-p)=0.0484 a constant base-rate forecast scores under this definition, so it is a different quantity and the two are not comparable.
metric_definitions.bss: 1 - brier / brier(constant base-rate forecast). The primary number, because a rare event flatters raw Brier.
metric_definitions.ece: bin-weighted mean |forecast - observed| over 10 equal-width bins, sharing one binning function with the reliability diagram so the two cannot disagree.
metric_definitions.winner_hit: fraction of races whose argmax p_win equals the classified winner.
metric_definitions.top3: fraction of races where the classified winner is in the top 3 by p_win.
metric_definitions.podium_recall: fraction of the actual top 3 appearing in the predicted top 3.
metric_definitions.spearman: rank correlation of expected finishing position against classification, average ranks with tie handling.
metric_definitions.murphy: BS = reliability - resolution + uncertainty over the same 10 bins.

claim_licence.rung_1_replay_fidelity: SUPPORTED: 22/22 stint parity, DNF matches Jolpica, fault injection and the Invariant-4 leakage tests pass.
claim_licence.rung_2_same_model_speed: SUPPORTED: 28.1x over optimised NumPy at |p_win| divergence 0.0123, below the Monte Carlo sampling floor. Withheld automatically if the arms diverge.
claim_licence.rung_3_outcome_calibration: PENDING this final test. Reportable only from the 2025 result, and only against the metric definitions above.
claim_licence.rung_4_option_contrast: PARTIAL: paired simultaneous CIs and the abstention rule are implemented and tested; stability across N is published in the ladder.
claim_licence.rung_5_decision_quality: NOT SUPPORTED and not claimed. The six-row evidence table is not built. We may claim option contrasts; we may not claim better pit decisions.
